source: house-style template A "They said I'd fail" (docs/house-style, after nateassets DcP_aC_AoQz); new characters and lines for fomo
note: An editor's first draft: a slow start, missing screens, a telling line, a made-up screen and a callback with no setup. No line changes; the marks add only what we see, and problems in the words become notes.
input:
<brand>
Brand: fomo
Required screens. Every shot at one of these moments shows the matching screen, attached as a reference image and shown exactly:
- screen:1 "Home" (mobile, home) — required at: fomo-mention, app-open
- screen:2 "Token chart up" (mobile, trading, chart-up) — required at: trading, win
- screen:3 "Token chart down" (mobile, trading, chart-down) — required at: trading, loss
- screen:4 "Desktop trading" (desktop, trading) — required at: trading-desktop
Moments: app-open, fomo-mention, loss, trading, trading-desktop, win
</brand>
<cast>
char:1 Malik, 17, red beanie, grey hoodie, headphones round his neck
char:2 Aunt Tasha, his aunt, neat bob, cardigan
</cast>
<script>
1| SCENE 1 — INT. KITCHEN — DAY
2| Malik eats cereal. Aunt Tasha reads the news on her tablet.
3| TASHA: Morning.
4| MALIK: Morning.
5| TASHA: Five hundred dollars, Malik. Gone?
6| MALIK: I put it in fomo.
7| TASHA: That's your college money!
8| MALIK: Thirty days. Watch me.
9| Malik goes upstairs. He is nervous because he might lose it all.
10| He checks the app every night.
11| ★ fomo screen: Wallet — showing his balance
12| SCENE 3 — INT. KITCHEN — DAY
13| Malik slides his phone across the counter.
14| TASHA: That's… real?
15| MALIK: Still want me bagging groceries?
</script>

anchor.quote: TASHA: Five hundred dollars, Malik. Gone?

suggestions.text: Close-up on Tasha, push in, as she slams his empty piggy bank on the counter.
suggestions.reason: Puts the fight and the money on screen in the first second.

anchor.quote: MALIK: I put it in fomo.

suggestions.text: ★ fomo screen: Home — on the phone Malik holds up
suggestions.reason: Saying fomo is a brand moment, so the real home screen shows.

suggestions.text: Tasha leans in nose to nose with him, one brow up; he doesn't blink.
suggestions.reason: The dare needs a held face-off so the payoff has something to answer.

suggestions.text: Alone in his dark room, Malik drops his head onto his arms in the blue phone glow.
suggestions.reason: Shows the low point the next sentence only tells.

anchor.quote: He checks the app every night.

suggestions.text: ★ fomo screen: Token chart down — on his phone, cold blue light on his face
suggestions.reason: The nights of trading are a fomo moment; the real chart-down screen is the low point.

anchor.quote: ★ fomo screen: Wallet — showing his balance

suggestions.text: ★ fomo screen: Token chart up — fills the frame
suggestions.reason: The turn is a win, and fomo's real win screen is Token chart up.

anchor.quote: Malik slides his phone across the counter.

suggestions.text: ★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on the phone as it stops in front of Tasha
suggestions.reason: The proof Tasha sees has to be the real fomo screen.

suggestions.text: Tasha grabs the phone with both hands; her eyes snap wide before she screams.
suggestions.reason: Her scream is the comic button the payoff needs.

notes.text: Lines 2–4 are breakfast small talk before the fight; the video would hook faster if it opened on line 5.
"He is nervous because he might lose it all" tells what the picture should show; the reaction mark after it covers it on screen.
"Wallet" isn't one of fomo's screens; the mark after this line uses Token chart up.
The script jumps to SCENE 3 with no scene 2, and the night trading (lines 9–11) is a new place and time.
"Bagging groceries" calls back to a threat Tasha never makes in scene 1, so the punchline has no setup.
